messages:
Sasha (partnerships): Kickoff: LangChain + LlamaIndex want a combined guidance doc on gateway patterns and orchestration (Prefect/Argo/Flyte) for Redwood Dedicated & Private. Aim: best-practice patterns, sample configs, and SI runbook. Meeting Friday 11am PT.

Marco (eng-platform): Love it. Focus on routing semantics: per-route fallbacks, prefix/KV cache interactions, and quantization caveats. Short diagram + JSON compatibility matrix.

Priya (eng-ml): I'll handle LlamaIndex-specific notes: vectorstore batching, tokenizer edge-cases, embedding model mismatch, and quantization tradeoffs (4-bit, 8-bit). Will include perf deltas for short/medium/long contexts.

Jordan (devex): I'll draft sample repo with LangChain adapters, one native SDK example, and a Prefect flow. Plan: README, 3 notebooks (retrieval, generation, hybrid), Dockerfile, and a tiny demo CLI. Suggest publishing under redwood-samples.

Nora (sales): Please include an SI appendix with SOW bullets and migration playbook (OSS gateway -> Redwood Dedicated). Acme asked for on-prem architecture + handoff checklist.

Devops (eng-infra): We have gateway routing in staging behind a flag. I'll produce the infra runbook, network diagrams, and sample K8s manifests for Private deploy.

Sasha (partnerships): Proposed structure: 1) Quickstart (adapter + native), 2) Orchestration patterns (Prefect/Argo/Flyte), 3) Gateway routing & fallbacks, 4) LlamaIndex appendix, 5) SI playbook + SOW.

Jordan (devex): Example CLI snippet to include in quickstart:
```
redwood config set --batch adaptive --cache prefix --quantize int4
prefect deploy --name redwood-lc-demo flow.yaml
```

Marco (eng-platform): Heads up: Dedicated supports tenant routing alpha; need per-route fallback flag. I'll provide a table mapping GPU types -> supported quantization/kernels by Thu. Also will add recommended batching windows to avoid KV cache thrashing.

Priya (eng-ml): One more: include a short section on embedding model selection and vectorstore consistency when using LlamaIndex. Add multilingual example (EN + JP) and a small benchmark for write throughput.

integrations-bot: Reminder: complete partner metadata form -> https://go/internal/partner-checklist

Sasha (partnerships): Action items: Jordan -> sample repo and configs by Wed EOD; Priya -> LlamaIndex appendix + perf numbers by Thu; Marco -> platform demo Wed + GPU/quant matrix; Devops -> infra runbook + k8s manifests Thu; Nora -> SI appendix & SOW bullets. I'll send invite for Friday kickoff. :thumbsup:

Jordan (devex): Quick question: adapters first or native SDK? My vote: adapters first (most customers), plus one native example for deep integration.

Nora (sales): Adapters first, and add a slide on migration path and hybrid mode (gateway + Dedicated burst).

Sasha (partnerships): Agreed. If anyone hits blockers DM me. Thanks all!
